text: 毕马威8日发布《2026年中国证券业调查报告》显示，2026年上半年，中国150家证券公司合计实现营业收入同比增逾三成。报告称，2026年上半年，中国150家证券公司合计实现营业收入3298亿元(人民币)，同比增长约31%，净利润1387亿元，同比增长23%。收入结构上，自营业务稳居第一大收入来源，经纪、投行、资管、信用业务均实现增长。（中新网）
text_en: KPMG released the 2026 China Securities Industry Survey Report on the 8th, showing that in the first half of 2026, China's 150 securities companies achieved total operating revenue growth of more than 30% year-on-year. The report said that in the first half of 2026, China's 150 securities companies achieved total operating revenue of 329.8 billion yuan (RMB), up about 31% year-on-year, and net profit of 138.7 billion yuan, up 23% year-on-year. In terms of revenue structure, proprietary trading remained the largest source of revenue, while brokerage, investment banking, asset management and credit businesses all achieved growth. (China News Service)
